name: Raspberry Falls & Mt Fox
description:
Walk Leader: Cherry Judge 

Location: Paluma Range National Park, North Queensland, Australia

Difficulty: Grade 2-3, off-track,Wading through creeks to get to falls, Dirt Track. Relatively flat. 
Mt Fox - Short steep ascent and descent - no track. 
Distance: Approximately 10 km one-way depending on route

Duration: Allow for 3-4 hours walking time and 6 hours driving time [return]

🌳About🌳

This adventure is taking us to the Girringun National Park, along a firebreak trail and along a creek to a set of falls called Raspberry Falls.
We first read about this on Wanderstories.space  when Luen explored this area in 2018. We are using this as our general guide to head out on this adventure.
Please take the time to read this article -
https://wanderstories.space/raspberry-falls/

It will take about 3 hours to drive to the starting point of the walk.
The walk itself is not a long walk - 5 kms return. It will however be slippery and steep in sections 
After Raspberry Falls, we will be [if time permits] heading around to Mt Fox to do a quick steep push to the summit and back

🌳What to bring:🌳
-Sunscreen and hat
-Insect repellent
Salt for Leeches.
Appropriate footwear- the rocks during some of the creek crossings are very slippery.
A walking stick might be useful in gauging water depth.
-Snacks, morning tea and lunch
-Water 
Personal First Aid kit and Snake Bandage x 2

RSVP:
If you have never walked with the TBWC before, please reach out to the walk leader to ascertain the suitability of this walk for you before you RSVP - Cherry Judge - 0430073341  or email - charismajudge@veteducation.com.au
Visitors are welcome - it is $5 to cover our club insurance. 
You can do 3 walks and qualify to become a TBWC member!

name: Little Gin Falls
description:
Walk Leader: Luen Warneke 

Location: Paluma Range National Park, North Queensland, Australia

Difficulty: Grade 5, off-track, difficult & steep. 

Distance: Approximately 10 km one-way depending on route

Duration: Allow 5-9 hours return

About: 

Starting at the Paluma Dam, follow the Paluma Dam to Jourama Falls Track marked trail. The path is primarily straightforward, but expect steep and uneven terrain. After covering the major part of this track, a subtle divergence indicates the start of your off-road venture. After about 10 km from the car, you'll find the remote beauty of Little Gin Creek. Though the falls themselves are not that spectacular, further downstream are a few more swimming pools and cascades beckon, each one more inviting than the last.

Meeting place:  will be emailed closer to the time.
